predefinedQueries.queryString: update entrasp.consuntivazioni cns1 set stato = COALESCE($stato$, cns2.stato), data_chiusura_ticket = COALESCE ($data_chiusura_ticket$, cns2.data_chiusura_ticket), note = CASE WHEN $note$ IS NOT NULL AND $note$ <> '' THEN CASE WHEN cns2.note IS NULL OR cns2.note = '' THEN $note$ ELSE cns2.note || ' - ' || $note$ END ELSE cns2.note END from entrasp.consuntivazioni cns2 where cns1.codice_azienda = cns2.codice_azienda and cns1.id_cons = cns2.id_cons and cns1.id_cons||'~'||cns1.codice_azienda in ($selected_rows_data$)

format.comboQuery: SELECT codice AS id, transcodifica AS name  FROM entrasp.transcodifiche WHERE tipo_dato='STATO_AZIONI_PROPOSTE';
